longBusinessSummary: Cargojet Inc. provides time-sensitive overnight air cargo services and carries in Canada. It operates domestic air cargo network services between Canadian cities; and provides aircraft to customers on an aircraft, crew, maintenance, and insurance basis operating between points in Canada, North America, South America, and Europe. The company also operates scheduled and ad hoc international routes for a range of cargo customers between the United States and Bermuda; Canada and Europe, Asia, and Mexico, the United Kingdom, and other international destinations.
